description: This file contains the implementation of Slim Framework's OutputBufferingMiddleware, which manages output buffering behavior (append or prepend) for HTTP responses within the Slim PHP framework.

classes.name: OutputBufferingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for buffering output and inserting it into the HTTP response body either by appending or prepending, depending on configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with a stream factory and style ('append' or 'prepend'). Validates the style parameter.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the request by starting output buffering, calling the next handler, capturing output, and inserting it into the response body according to the specified style.
